tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Amazon UK listings for CPUs, GPUs, RAM, motherboards and storage. Prices are in pence. Returns up to 10 results with current price, stock state, a product URL and buyUrl. A price last checked over 24 hours ago is null; buyUrl still leads to the live price. Use this to answer "what does X cost

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product by its numeric ID: name, brand, current price in pence (null when last checked over 24 hours ago), stock state and rating. buyUrl is the link to give a user who wants to buy it; never rebuild an Amazon link from the ASIN. IDs come from search_products.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Index of published articles on UK component pricing and buying advice, most recent first.

tools.name: get_best_value
tools.description: Rank listed storage by price per terabyte (unit "tb") or memory by price per gigabyte (unit "gb"), cheapest first, using current prices. Unit prices are in pence. The unit is required, because the two scales cannot be mixed in one ranking.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Amazon UK listings for CPUs, GPUs, RAM, motherboards and storage. Prices are in pence. Returns up to 10 results with current price, stock state, a product URL and buyUrl. Use this to answer "what does X cost" and "what is the cheapest Y". Give the user buyUrl when they want to buy: never rebu" → after: "Search Amazon UK listings for CPUs, GPUs, RAM, motherboards and storage. Prices are in pence. Returns up to 10 results with current price, stock state, a product URL and buyUrl. A price last checked over 24 hours ago is null; buyUrl still leads to the live price. Use this to answer "what does X cost"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
